about: US2: the price symbol for S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 membership tickers (data/sp500_membership.json, data/ndx_membership.json) that Yahoo no longer prices under that ticker. Each alias names the symbol that carries the same company's history, over the dates [from, until) of the membership ticker (null = the whole spell). Checked 15 Oct 2026: the alias's Yahoo history covers the spell, and its 2015-06-01 close matches the old company's level where noted. Anything not here is priced under its own ticker; companies that no longer trade come from Tiingo (US2 step 3).
